core.v-move: Moving & position (walk, run, sit, stand, approach, pass, return home, move house)
core.v-body: Body actions, senses & physical states (laugh, cry, sleep, fall over, hit, touch, smell, shake)
core.v-home: Daily routine, home & chores (wash, cook, clean, tidy, dress, prepare, live somewhere)
core.v-talk: Talking & communicating (call, tell, explain, apologise, refuse, chat, answer, invite, ask a favour)
core.v-mind: Thinking, knowing & feeling (believe, feel, remember, notice, worry, be surprised, be glad, doubt, understand)
core.v-social: People & relationships (help, forgive, trust, protect, leave it to, betray, go out with, marry, break up)
core.v-change: Change, start & end, more & less (continue, increase, disappear, break, change, get used to, be decided)
core.v-hands: Handling things (put, hand over, hide, find, collect, pick up, carry, deliver, receive, lose, fix)
core.v-effort: Work, effort & results (succeed, fail, win, lose, choose, be in time, check, practise, aim)
core.v-trouble: Trouble, conflict & danger (fight, steal, hurt, deceive, kill, run away, attack, get caught, threaten)
core.v-life: Life & living (be born, live, die, grow up, spend time, raise)
core.n-people: People, roles & relationships (person, woman, man, friend, senior, boss, customer, partner, couple)
core.n-life: Life, time & fate (life, future, past, memory, era, moment, chance, dream)
core.n-mind: Mind, feelings & character (feeling, happiness, anxiety, courage, confidence, personality, love)
core.n-abstract: Reasons, situations & ideas (reason, relation, case, situation, way, result, problem, meaning, fact, cause, purpose)
core.n-talk: Talk & information (story, opinion, reply, news, rumour, secret, lie, promise, question, answer)
core.n-places: Places & buildings (place, room, shop, station, hospital, school, company, town, country, world)
core.n-home: Home & everyday things (furniture, keys, wallet, phone, photo, letter, present, bag, clothes)
core.n-food: Food & drink (meal, rice, water, tea, alcohol, meat, fish, vegetables, sweets)
core.n-work: Work & school (job, meeting, documents, exam, class, homework, salary, part-time job)
core.n-health: Body, health & medicine (illness, injury, medicine, fever, cold, hospital visit, wound)
core.n-society: Society, rules & news (police, incident, accident, law, news, politics, rules, crime)
core.n-travel: Getting around & going out (train, car, trip, road, airport, hotel, date, event, party)
core.n-money: Money & shopping (money, price, payment, card, receipt, discount, cheap shop)
core.n-nature: Nature, animals & the outdoors (sky, sea, mountain, flower, tree, dog, cat, river)
core.n-fun: Free time, media & tech (hobby, film, music, game, match, song, smartphone, internet)
core.n-things: General nouns: things, kinds, parts & amounts (thing, shape, sound, voice, name, number, kind, half, rest)
core.a-feel: Adjectives of feeling & sensation (sad, lonely, frustrating, nostalgic, painful, sleepy, itchy, scary-feeling)
core.a-people: Adjectives describing people (strict, serious, honest, clever, young, admirable, cool, mean)
core.a-things: Adjectives describing things & situations (old, bright, dark, heavy, wide, far, strong, strange, special, safe, free)
core.adv-manner: Adverbs of manner, certainty & timing (definitely, properly, on purpose, suddenly, finally, directly, at once)
core.adv-degree: Degree words the main list lacks (totemo, zuibun, wari to, mattaku, daibu, sara ni, masumasu)
core.adv-mimetic: Sound & feeling words / mimetics (dokidoki, wakuwaku, iraira, gussuri, pittari, girigiri, perapera)
core.connect: Connectors & discourse words the main list lacks (soshite, sore ni, tokoro de, sore demo, sore to mo, chinami ni)

set.s-numbers: Sino-Japanese numbers 0-10, 100, 1,000, 10,000, 100 million, with reading variants and sound changes (yon/shi, nana/shichi, sanbyaku, roppyaku, sanzen, hassen)
set.s-people: Counting people: hitori, futari, sannin ... nannin
set.s-counters: Everyday counters and their sound changes: -ko, -hon, -mai, -hiki, -satsu, -dai, -hai, -kai (times), -kai (floor), -ban, -banme, -do, -en, -bai
set.s-clock: Clock time & durations: -ji (yoji, shichiji, kuji), -fun/-pun, han, nanji, -jikan, -funkan, -byou
set.s-weekdays: Days of the week, nan'youbi, heijitsu
set.s-dates: Days of the month: tsuitachi, futsuka ... touka, juuyokka, hatsuka, nijuuyokka, nannichi, -nichikan
set.s-months: Months & month counts: ichigatsu ... juunigatsu, nangatsu, ikkagetsu, nankagetsu
set.s-years: Years & age: -nen, -nenkan, -sai (issai, hassai, jussai, hatachi), nansai / oikutsu, -nensei
set.s-relative: Relative-time grid words the main list lacks: ototoi, asatte, sensenshuu, saraishuu, ototoshi, sarainen, maiasa, maiban, maishuu, maitsuki, mainen
set.s-dayparts: Parts of the day & meals: yuugata, yonaka, gozen, gogo, asagohan, hirugohan, bangohan (asa/hiru/yoru are in the main list)
set.s-seasons: Seasons & weather: haru, natsu, aki, fuyu, hare, kumori, yuki, kaze, taifuu, atatakai, suzushii, mushiatsui
set.s-colors: Colours: aka/akai, ao/aoi, kiiro, shiro/shiroi, kuro/kuroi, chairo, midori, murasaki, pinku, orenji, haiiro, iro
set.s-family: Family words, own vs someone else's (chichi/otousan, haha/okaasan, ani/oniisan ...) and the casual home forms (papa, mama, oniichan)
set.s-body: Body parts: atama, kao, me, mimi, hana, kuchi, ha, kubi, kata, te, ude, yubi, mune, onaka, senaka, koshi, ashi, hiza, kami
set.s-position: Position & direction the main list lacks: migi, hidari, tonari, yoko, soba, aida, mukou, oku, massugu, kado, kita, minami, higashi, nishi
set.s-pronouns: Personal pronouns & people-pointers the main list lacks: ore, atashi, anata, kimi, omae, anta, kare, kanojo, aitsu, koitsu, soitsu, yatsu, -ra, wareware
set.s-countries: Countries, languages & nationalities: nihon, -go, -jin, amerika, igirisu, chuugoku, kankoku, gaikoku
set.s-taste: Tastes & textures: amai, karai, shoppai, suppai, nigai, mazui, katai, yawarakai

phrase.ph-greet: Greetings, partings & home rituals (konbanwa, sayounara, mata ne, ittekimasu, tadaima, okaeri)
phrase.ph-thanks: Thanks & apologies (arigatou gozaimasu, doumo, sumimasen deshita, moushiwake arimasen, gomen nasai)
phrase.ph-manners: Polite formulas (shitsurei shimasu, ojama shimasu, osewa ni natte imasu, yoroshiku onegai shimasu, osaki ni)
phrase.ph-ask: Requests, offers & permission (onegai dekimasu ka, ii desu ka, tetsudaou ka, dou shitara ii?)
phrase.ph-shop: Shopping & paying (kore kudasai, ikura desu ka, kaado de ii desu ka, fukuro wa daijoubu desu)
phrase.ph-eat: Eating & drinking (kanpai, oishisou, onaka suita, okawari, okaikei onegai shimasu)
phrase.ph-staff: What staff say to you (irasshaimase, shoushou omachi kudasai, omatase shimashita, kashikomarimashita)
phrase.ph-phone: Phone, messages & meeting up (ima daijoubu?, ato de kakenaosu, tsuita yo, chotto okureru)
phrase.ph-care: Care, sympathy & encouragement (odaiji ni, muri shinaide, taihen datta ne, ki ni shinaide)
phrase.ph-celebrate: Congratulations & seasonal wishes (otanjoubi omedetou, akemashite omedetou, yoi otoshi o)
phrase.ph-react: Reactions & exclamations (yatta, yoshi, uwa, maji de?, shimatta, mou!)
phrase.ph-talk: Keeping talk going & clarifying (ano sa, chotto kiite, dou omou?, sou iu koto ka)
phrase.ph-trouble: Problems & emergencies (tasukete, michi ni mayotta, saifu o nakushita, kyuukyuusha o yonde)
phrase.ph-feel: Saying how you are (tsukareta, nemui, onaka ippai, tanoshikatta, kinchou suru)

move.c-intro: Getting to know someone: introducing yourself and asking about job, studies, hometown, family, where you live, how long you've been here, why you came (shigoto nani shiteru no?, shusshin doko?, nihon ni kite dono gurai?)
move.c-likes: Likes, hobbies and free time: what you like, are into, do on weekends (shumi wa?, yasumi no hi nani shiteru?, ...ni hamatteru, ...tte suki?)
move.c-opine: What do you think: asking for and giving opinions on a topic, comparing views (dou omou?, ...tte dou?, watashi wa ... ha kana, ...to omou kedo, sore wa chotto ...)
move.c-catchup: Small talk and catching up (saikin dou?, isogashii?, atsui ne, shuumatsu nani shita?, kawari nai?)
move.c-react: Reacting and backchannelling: showing you're listening and how you feel about it (hee, maji de?, sugoi, uso!, sore na, wakaru, naruhodo ne)
move.c-ask: Asking and following up: keeping the other person talking (de, dou datta?, sore de?, nande?, itsu kara?, dare to itta no?)
move.c-agree: Agreeing and disagreeing, softly or firmly (da yo ne, tashika ni, sou ka na, iya, sore wa chigau to omou)
move.c-tell: Telling what happened: sequencing, quoting, building to the point (sore de, sono ato, kekkyoku, ...tte itteta, ...n da kedo sa)
move.c-feel: Feelings and empathy (ureshii!, mukatsuku, taihen datta ne, ki ni shinaide, wakaru, sore wa tsurai ne)
move.c-plans: Plans and invitations (kondo ... shinai?, hima?, ii ne, ikou!, mata kondo ne, nanji ni suru?)
move.c-repair: Clarifying and repair when you're lost (e, nani?, dou iu imi?, mou ikkai, tte iu ka, nante iu ka, chotto matte)
move.c-banter: Teasing, joking and banter (joudan da yo, uso da yo, ii na~, zurui, yarou ka?, dasai)
move.c-flow: Opening, closing and changing the subject (nee kiite, tokoro de, sou ieba, hanashi kawaru kedo, jaa sorosoro)
move.c-social: Greetings, thanks and apologies between friends (hisashiburi!, mata ne, arigatou ne, gomen ne, otsukare)
move.c-errands: Errands, service and formal settings: shopping, eating out, what staff say, phone and business politeness, travel, emergencies
